sloka: स सम्प्रतस्थे धर्मात्मा प्रीतो दशरथात्मज: ।वृतो महत्या नादिन्या सेनया चतुरङ्गया ॥ २.९३.३॥
transliteration: sa sampratasthe dharmātmā prīto daśarathātmaja: ।vṛto mahatyā nādinyā senayā caturaṅgayā ॥ 2.93.3॥

translations.english: Bharata the righteous son of Dasaratha, proceeded with great delight in the company of the clamouring army of four divisions.
